name: Love Stories: Furry Shades of Gay
source:
Love Stories is a game about love. Also it's a game about slapstick happenstance, queer relationships, and hot gay sex. Five furry stories full of humor, wit, tough decisions, and sweaty, raunchy humping.

Nonetheless, not everyone is up to jump in the sack right away. You'll have to navigate the heroes around their insecurities and hang-ups, then they'll have their happily ever after. Well, maybe not that, but at least one good romp is guaranteed!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1399930/Love_Stories_Furry_Shades_of_Gay/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Love Stories》是一款关于爱的游戏，也充满了滑稽的巧合、酷儿之间的感情，以及火热的男男性爱。五段兽人故事，满载幽默、机智、艰难的抉择，还有汗水淋漓、放浪的交欢。

不过，并非人人都愿意立刻上床。你得引导主人公们克服不安与心结，他们才能迎来幸福的结局。好吧，也许未必能幸福到最后，但至少能痛快地享受一回！

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1399930/Love_Stories_Furry_Shades_of_Gay/]Steam[/url]]
